log.text: Light Screen up on P2's side

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks Fake Out/Follow Me, enabling safe Trick Room. Gardevoir provides backup TR and Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice. Kingambit OHKOs Gengar-Mega with Dark STAB. Hatterene is third TR setter with Magic Bounce and Life Orb Dazzling Gleam for Annihilape. Triple TR ensures speed control against fast Talonflame/Maushold.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead: Farigiraf+Gardevoir, back Kingambit+Hatterene. Opponent has Gengar-Mega (Shadow Tag trapper), Grimmsnarl (Prankster screens), Annihilape (Rage Fist buildup), Primarina (Liquid Voice Hyper Voice), Maushold (Follow Me+Population Bomb), Talonflame (Gale Wings). Armor Tail blocks all opposing priority including Fake Out, Follow Me, and Gale Wings. Kingambit Dark STAB is 2x on Gengar-Mega. Ghost types can escape Shadow Tag but I have none. Plan: set Trick Room turn 1, Mega Gardevoir, pivot to Kingambit for Gengar.

decisions.rationale: Lead Mega Gengar + Grimmsnarl: Fake Out/screens enable Gengar trap-delete on Kingambit/Fairies while denying free TR. Back Ape+Primarina for Rage Fist/Inner Focus into Intimidate and Liquid Voice HV pressure on Arcanine/Noivern.
decisions.notebook: Matchup build: Shadow Tag Mega Gengar traps Kingambit/Fairies; Prankster Grimmsnarl screens+Fake Out enable Rage Fist Ape (Inner Focus ignores Intimidate); Liquid Voice Primarina HV into Arcanine/Noivern. Maushold FG+Follow Me/Tidy and GW Talon Tailwind/WoW for speed control/redirection. Opp: TR core (Farigiraf Armor Tail, Mega Gard Pixilate, Hatterene MB, Kingambit SO, H-Arcanine Intim, Noivern Infiltrator sash Tailwind/Taunt). Priority into Farigiraf fails. Screens help vs special TR. Save Talon/Maus for later speed/redirect.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gardevoir)
decisions.rationale: Farigiraf sets Trick Room while Mega Gardevoir OHKOs Gengar (Mega or not) with Psychic. Armor Tail blocks Grimmsnarl's Fake Out. Even if they double-target Gardevoir and KO it before it moves, Trick Room still goes up and Kingambit enters for free to threaten Gengar with Dark STAB. The aggressive line maximizes early pressure and aligns with the game plan.
Mega+Sludge Gard (best SE damage, Shadow Tag now). Armor Tail blocks FO on Fari; FO Gard denies HV/Psychic/Protect while we outspeed TR. Screens next.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Shadow Tag Mega Gengar traps Kingambit/Fairies; Prankster Grimm screens+FO enable Rage Fist Ape (Inner Focus ignores Intim); Liquid Voice Prim HV into Arcanine/Noivern. Opp TR core: Fari ArmorTail (priority into it/allies fails), Mega Gard Pixilate, Hatterene MB, Kingambit SO, H-Arcanine Intim, Noivern Infiltrator sash Tailwind/Taunt. Screens help vs special TR. Light Clay Grimm. Save Ape/Primarina; no Maus/Talon this game.

decisions.rationale: Forced switch only; Grimm passes. Gard 8% under TR: Prim Spe 80 acts before Gard and can KO safely. Ape 143 is faster than Gard so moves after and risks SE Psychic OHKO (90-123%). Prim also takes HV/Psychic fine; save Ape for post-chip/Kingambit.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Shadow Tag Mega Gengar traps Kingambit/Fairies; Prankster Grimm screens+FO enable Rage Fist Ape (Inner Focus ignores Intim); Liquid Voice Prim HV into Arcanine/Noivern. Opp TR core: Fari ArmorTail (priority into it/allies fails), Mega Gard Pixilate, Hatterene MB, Kingambit SO, H-Arcanine Intim, Noivern Infiltrator sash Tailwind/Taunt. Screens help vs special TR. Light Clay Grimm. Save Ape for Kingambit/post-TR; Prim handles TR specials. No Maus/Talon this game.

decisions.rationale: Gardevoir at 9% moves last under Trick Room and is KO'd before acting if it stays. Switching to Kingambit preserves Gardevoir as a backup TR setter and brings in a Dark/Steel resist that threatens both foes. Farigiraf Psychic chips Primarina (22–39%) while Armor Tail blocks any Prankster-targeted moves. Kingambit enters safely, and under TR next turn its 63 Speed underspeeds Primarina/Grimmsnarl for a strong Kowtow Cleave.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Farigiraf+Gardevoir lead, Kingambit+Hatterene back. Turn 1: TR up (Farigiraf), Gardevoir Mega'd and OHKO'd Gengar-Mega with Psychic but took Sludge Bomb to 9%. Opponent brought Primarina after Gengar fainted. Turn 2: switched Gardevoir→Kingambit, Farigiraf Psychic'd Primarina. TR ~4 turns remain. Gardevoir-Mega preserved at 9% for emergency TR reset. Kingambit (Black Glasses, Brave, 63 Spe) underspeeds both foes under TR. Hatterene (Life Orb, Quiet, 44 Spe) in back. Opponent has Annihilape, Maushold, Talonflame unrevealed.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Primarina)
decisions.rationale: TR active: KO 8% Gard with LO Liquid Voice HV (Water STAB spread) while chipping Fari; Prankster LS goes up safely (Armor Tail only blocks foe-targeted prio). Screens blunt their special TR core. Spirit Break only 0.5x into Gard.

Kingambit Iron Head into Grimmsnarl: 78.7–151.8%, strong OHKO chance before Reflect. Farigiraf Hyper Voice spreads chip to both foes, securing Grimmsnarl KO on low rolls and pressuring Primarina. Kingambit moves first under TR; Grimmsnarl can't set Reflect in time. Removing Grimmsnarl denies screens and isolates Primarina for cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Farigiraf+Gardevoir lead, Kingambit+Hatterene back. TR set turn 1. Gardevoir-Mega OHKO'd Gengar-Mega, preserved at 9% for emergency TR reset. Turn 2: Gardevoir→Kingambit switch, Farigiraf Psychic'd Primarina. Opponent back: Annihilape, Maushold, Talonflame unrevealed. Primarina is Life Orb Liquid Voice Modest; Grimmsnarl is Light Clay Prankster Careful with Reflect/Light Screen/Spirit Break/Fake Out. Kingambit Black Glasses Brave 63 Spe underspeeds both foes under TR. Hatterene Life Orb Quiet 44 Spe in back.

decisions.rationale: TR favors our Spe80 pair vs Fari/King. Reflect + HV pressures both; LS already up. Spirit Break risks KO fail vs King SO/BlackGlasses. Protect wastes tempo. Ape later for King. HV chips Fari for berry/Sitrus and King.

Kingambit Iron Head guaranteed KOs 21% Grimmsnarl through Reflect (min 39.3%), removing the screen setter. Farigiraf Psychic chips Primarina to ~23-34%. Both move first under TR. Primarina may Moonblast Farigiraf for 25-52% through Light Screen — a KO risk but worth taking to secure the 2v1. Hatterene and Gardevoir-Mega clean up if Farigiraf falls.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Farigiraf+Gardevoir lead, Kingambit+Hatterene back. TR set turn 1. Gardevoir-Mega OHKO'd Gengar-Mega, preserved at 9% for emergency TR reset. Turn 2: Gardevoir→Kingambit switch, Farigiraf Psychic'd Primarina. Turn 3: Kingambit Iron Head→Grimmsnarl, Farigiraf Hyper Voice, Primarina Hyper Voice. Opponent back: Annihilape (Jolly Leftovers InnerFocus), Maushold (Jolly WideLens FriendGuard), Talonflame (Jolly FocusSash GaleWings). Primarina Life Orb Liquid Voice Modest; Grimmsnarl Light Clay Prankster Careful. Kingambit Black Glasses Brave 63 Spe; Hatterene Life Orb Quiet 44 Spe. Screens persist after Grimmsnarl faints (Light Clay: 8 turns). Supreme Overlord: 1 fallen ally (Gardevoir) = 1.1x.

decisions.rationale: Both remaining Pokémon must enter. Hatterene (44 Spe) is slower than Gardevoir-Mega (108 Spe) and will move first under Trick Room against Primarina (80–112). Slot assignment is arbitrary since both are special spread attackers; Hatterene to slot 1, Gardevoir-Mega to slot 2.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Farigiraf+Gardevoir lead, Kingambit+Hatterene back. TR set turn 1. Gardevoir-Mega OHKO'd Gengar-Mega, preserved at 9% for emergency TR reset. Turn 2: Gardevoir→Kingambit switch, Farigiraf Psychic'd Primarina. Turn 3: Kingambit Iron Head→Grimmsnarl, Farigiraf Hyper Voice, Primarina Hyper Voice. Turn 4: Kingambit KO'd Grimmsnarl; Farigiraf and Kingambit both fainted to Primarina Hyper Voice. Opponent back: Annihilape (Jolly Leftovers InnerFocus), Maushold (Jolly WideLens FriendGuard), Talonflame (Jolly FocusSash GaleWings). Primarina Life Orb Liquid Voice Modest; Grimmsnarl Light Clay Prankster Careful. Screens persist (Light Clay): Light Screen 6 turns, Reflect 7 turns. Trick Room 2 turns remain. Supreme Overlord: 1 fallen ally = 1.1x (now irrelevant). Gardevoir-Mega 9% HP, Hatterene 100% HP remain.

decisions.rationale: Liquid Voice HV is Water: KOs 10% Kingambit (spread) and chips 40% Fari (possible KO). Grimm SB Fari if it lives. King IH likely KOs 21% Grimm thru Reflect first in TR; Ape then enters free w/ opp replacement. Hard-switch Ape worse (takes free hit). Screens hold.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Hatterene Psychic into Primarina is a guaranteed KO through Light Screen (min 21.95% > 21%). Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice is immune into Annihilape, so Psychic is the only damaging option. Hatterene always moves before Primarina under TR. After KO, only Annihilape remains; its Rage Fist does 34-49% to Hatterene through Reflect, survivable. TR ends after this turn, setting up a 2v1 endgame.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 endgame: Opponent brought Primarina (Life Orb Liquid Voice Modest), Annihilape (Leftovers InnerFocus Jolly), Grimmsnarl (Light Clay Prankster Careful), Gengar-Mega (Timid). Maushold and Talonflame not brought. Screens from Light Clay Grimmsnarl: Reflect 6 turns, Light Screen 5 turns remaining as of turn 5. Trick Room expires after turn 5. Hatterene Life Orb Quiet 44 Spe is slowest under TR. Gardevoir-Mega Quiet 108 Spe. Kingambit and Farigiraf fainted. Supreme Overlord reached only 1 fallen ally (1.1x). Hatterene Psychic OHKOs Primarina through Light Screen. Annihilape Rage Fist does 34-49% to Hatterene through Reflect.

decisions.rationale: TR 1 turn left; both Protect. Under TR Hat/Gard Psychic OHKOs Ape even through LS; anything OHKOs 21% Prim. Double Protect wastes their attacks, ends TR, then Ape outspeeds all and Prim outspeeds Hat with screens up to clean.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gardevoir-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Trick Room flips speed control for the rest of the game. Gardevoir-Mega Protect (+4 priority) blocks Annihilape's likely Rage Fist KO. Hatterene survives even double-target worst case (~75-108% only if Moonblast rolls high with Reflect Rage Fist; Hyper Voice + Rage Fist is 59-85%). TR goes up last, then Hatterene outspeeds both foes next turn and KOs Primarina with Psychic, then cleans Annihilape.

Ape outspeeds and Rage Fists 8% Gard for free KO (SE Ghost). Prim then Moonblasts Hatt (best single-target; LO STAB ~54-100%) before Hatt moves. Must remove Gard first or it Psychics Prim through LS. Screens + dual Protect last turn make stall worse; consecutive Protect fails often.

Hatterene Dazzling Gleam under TR always moves first: min 19.6% through Light Screen KOs 11% Primarina before it acts, and deals 40–71% to Annihilape. Gardevoir Psychic adds 53–94%, combined 93–165% — Annihilape almost always faints. Even on double low roll, a 50 BP Rage Fist through Reflect rarely KOs 21% Hatterene, leaving a clean follow-up.

TR order: Hatt then Prim then Gard then Ape. Hatt any attack KOs 11% Prim through LS; either Psychic OHKOs Ape through LS. Only double Protect keeps both alive. Gard Protect success already reduced if they try again. Stall, keep screens/TR, reassess.

Hatterene moves first under TR and Dazzling Gleam KOs Primarina (14.7% min through Light Screen > 11%) while chipping Annihilape 29.95-52.7%. Gardevoir then Psychics Annihilape for 39.85-70.25%, combined 69.8-122.95% — high KO chance. Primarina never acts, eliminating speed-tie risk. If Annihilape survives, Gardevoir moves before it next turn and can finish with Psychic.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 turn 8: Opponent Annihilape Rage Fist is at base 50 BP (0 hits taken since entering turn 4). Reflect 3 turns left, Light Screen 2 turns left. Primarina Life Orb Liquid Voice Modest. Both foes' Protect success rates reduced after turn 7 Protects. Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate turns Hyper Voice into 108 BP Fairy STAB spread. Hatterene Life Orb recoil drops it to 11% after attacking, making it vulnerable to any Rage Fist.

decisions.rationale: TR: Hatt>Prim>Gard>Ape. HV (Liquid Voice Water) KOes both low-HP foes through screens; Ape Rage Fist Hatt as backup if needed. Avoid Protect fail risk.

reflections.summary: Game was won because opponent's double Protect on turns 5 and 7 allowed us to reset Trick Room and sweep with Gardevoir and Hatterene, despite losing two Pokemon early and Gardevoir entering at 9% HP.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, anticipate Talonflame for Tailwind; lead with Farigiraf and Hatterene to guarantee Trick Room against Fake Out; preserve Gardevoir's HP; avoid giving Annihilape free turns to Bulk Up or Rage Fist boosts.
reflections.notebook: Opponent tends to use double Protect with Annihilape and Primarina to stall Trick Room. Grimmsnarl carries Light Clay, Reflect, Light Screen, Fake Out, Spirit Break. Annihilape is Jolly, Leftovers, Inner Focus, with Rage Fist, Close Combat, Bulk Up, Protect; it aims to set up behind screens. Primarina is Modest, Life Orb, Liquid Voice, with Hyper Voice, Moonblast, Ice Beam, Protect. They did not bring Talonflame or Maushold this game; Talonflame likely has Tailwind and Focus Sash to counter Trick Room. Future plan: bring anti-Fake Out lead (Farigiraf) with a Trick Room setter; target Annihilape with special attacks before Bulk Up; consider stalling Tailwind or screens with Protect.

reflections.summary: Lost due to team-preview mismatch: bringing and Mega Evolving Gengar into opp's full TR core (Fari/Mega Gard/Hatt/King) left frail offense and Ape/Prim exposed to SE Psychic/Gleam pressure once supports died, despite screens.
reflections.adjustment: Bench Gengar (do not Mega it) next game; preview a different four with better TR answers or breakers (e.g. involve Maus/Talon) while keeping Grimm screens + Ape/Prim.
reflections.notebook: Opp hard-commits TR core: Fari (Armor Tail Sitrus Relaxed TR/Psychic/HV/Protect) + Hatt (LO Magic Bounce Quiet TR/Psychic/DG/Protect) setters, Mega Gard (Quiet Gardevoirite HV/Psychic/Protect/TR), King (BG SO Brave Kowtow/Sucker/IH/Protect). Re-sets TR via Hatt post-Fari. Armor Tail blanks priority into core. H-Arcanine/Noivern still in back. Screens + Ape (save vs King/post-TR) + Prim still usable but Gengar poor into this; next preview avoid Gengar/Mega vs TR, prep for Arcanine/Noivern mix or second TR game.
